response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate FROM album_stats WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.AlbumId, s.avg_unit_price, s.bytes_per_ms, s.bytes_per_ms - o.avg_rate AS rate_diff FROM album_stats s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.AlbumId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rate_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The album rate counts only tracks with a non-null Bytes value, in both the numerator and the denominator, so missing Bytes values are ignored rather than treated as zero.
The NULL-AlbumId group is computed but excluded from the ranking and from the cross-album average, because it is not an album.
The average rate across all albums is the unweighted mean of the per-album rates, so each album counts equally.
The difference is the album rate minus the average album rate. It can be negative, and the ordering is descending by that value.
No ROUND is applied to any value, as the request specifies.

alternatives.interpretation: The album rate uses literal totals: SUM(Bytes) divided by SUM(Milliseconds) over all tracks in the album, with missing Bytes counted as zero in the numerator and all milliseconds in the denominator.
